QUOTE: A project can substitute its own allocator at compile time with two macros, or at runtime with `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`. ... `platform.c:16-22` says the compile-time macros take precedence. When both macros are set, the runtime setter and its pointers are compiled out entirely.

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It also says that with both macros defined, the runtime setter and its pointers are compiled out, which is mutual exclusion.
